claims: Ryan Coogler's Sinners secured 16 nominations at the 2026 Oscars.
16 nominations is the most ever for a single film at the Oscars.
Sinners won four awards at the 2026 Oscars.
Sinners had 12 total losses at the 2026 Oscars.
Sinners' 16 nominations surpassed Titanic, La La Land, and All About Eve.
Ryan Coogler won Best Original Screenplay for Sinners at the 2026 Oscars.
Michael B. Jordan won Best Actor for Sinners at the 2026 Oscars.
Michael B. Jordan played twins Elijah and Elias in Sinners.
Autumn Durald Arkapaw won Best Cinematography for Sinners at the 2026 Oscars.
Autumn Durald Arkapaw is the first woman to win Best Cinematography.
Ludwig Göransson won Best Original Score for Sinners at the 2026 Oscars.
Sinners was nominated for Best Picture at the 2026 Oscars.
Ryan Coogler, Zinzi Coogler, and Sev Ohanian produced Sinners for its Best Picture nomination.
Delroy Lindo was nominated for Best Supporting Actor for Sinners at the 2026 Oscars.
Sinners was nominated for Casting at the 2026 Oscars.
Yahoo was nominated for Casting for Sinners at the 2026 Oscars.
Sinners was nominated for Makeup and Hairstyling at the 2026 Oscars.
Yahoo was nominated for Makeup and Hairstyling for Sinners at the 2026 Oscars.
Sinners was nominated in every category it was eligible for at the 2026 Oscars including technical categories.
Sinners is an original spec script.
Sinners is not a franchise installment.
Sinners is a horror-thriller.
